title: Direct release workflow: no release PR, tag and GitHub release on main push

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Design: push to main = promotion. Workflow runs release-plz update (bump Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock + CHANGELOG.md from conventional commits), commits directly to main with GITHUB_TOKEN, then release-plz release creates the tag and GitHub release (publish=false, crates.io untouched for now). No PR is opened at any point; the 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' repo setting becomes irrelevant; B's PR-permission check and RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN fallback removed. workflow_dispatch with dry_run (default true) computes next version + tag without pushing/tagging/releasing. Loop safety: GITHUB_TOKEN pushes do not retrigger workflows, and release-plz release is idempotent against existing tags (v1.0.0 from semantic-release noted: 123 commits since that tag, no GH release attached — dry run will show computed next version; tag not touched by me). Existing v1.0.0 tag accounted for in dry run. Cargo publish dry-run to be reported (size/metadata/fixtures), but publishing stays off until the maintainer sets up crates.io.

comments.author: example-user

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Dry-run verified (run 37073639742, workflow_dispatch dry_run=true on develop, green): computed next version 0.1.0 (0.x as required; note: not the 0.2.0 the maintainer expected — see report: with no registry release and no tag, release-plz ships the current manifest version as the first release; version bumps from conventional commits kick in from the second release onward, once botspy 0.1.0 exists in the registry/tag), changelog diff +168 lines ([0.1.0] entry with all commits), and the skip list shows exactly what a real promotion would do: [cargo registry upload, creation of tag 'v0.1.0', creation of git release] — a direct release plus crates.io publish, no PR. 48 stale release-plz-* branches deleted (all release-plz-* on the remote; zero remain). All develop CI runs green. Task stays in_progress until the first real release from main completes.

Verified: cargo search shows 0.1.0; cargo install botspy --locked into /tmp/botspy-install-check succeeded, --version reports botspy 0.1.0; 'botspy sources' lists 5 sources (claude_code 45 sessions, ok); 'botspy sessions --limit 5' lists 5 sessions; temp install removed. Synced back to develop by fast-forward (b6a9033..93ff67d), CI 37082028507 green on all 8 jobs. Closing.
